claim: One session. 11 continuous days. 1.5k production commits. Hard systems-level code.

scope.verificationSource: Reachable Git commit objects in the verified repository snapshot
scope.refScope: All local and remote refs available at verification time
scope.productionCommitDefinition: A commit in the product repository during the session, including runtime code, tests, infrastructure, proof artifacts, and release documentation required to ship or verify the system.

session.dayCountingRule: The headline reports completed 24-hour days between the boundary commits. The remaining 22 hours and 55 minutes are retained in this record.

commits.roundingRule: The headline reports repository commit volume at 0.5k precision; 1,437 is displayed as 1.5k.

systemSurfaceTouches.method: A commit is counted once for each top-level product surface it touched, so surface counts can overlap.

qualification: This is an inspectable repository-history build record. It is not a customer performance benchmark, a claim that every commit was deployed independently, or evidence of external production adoption.
